Wimbledon Tennis Tournament Continues with Upsets and Records

The Wimbledon tennis tournament is underway, with several top players facing off in the early rounds. Naomi Osaka has made a strong start by defeating world number one Iga Sabalenka in straight sets to reach the quarterfinals. Meanwhile, Novak Djokovic has broken Roger Federer's record for most match wins at Wimbledon with his 106th win. The tournament is expected to continue with more upsets and exciting matches.
